Personal.name: Personal
Personal.description: Small ships, can land on planets, can carry small weapons but not enough to seriously damage larger ships

Corvette.name: Corvette
Corvette.description: Large ships, cannot land on planets, must stay in orbit and use shuttles to land

Frigate.name: Frigate
Frigate.description: Huge ships, cannot land on planets, often battleships with numerous heavy weapons

Dreadnought.name: Dreadnought
Dreadnought.description: Massive ships, cannot land on planets, usually the flagship of a large fleet or a mobile base for smaller ships

Freighter.name: Freighter
Freighter.description: Medium ships, can land on planets, most common ship size
